name: gradient-space-shift

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the entire panel with the indigo corner and mint corner both fully in view.

tagline: Indigo sweeps diagonally through blue and cyan into mint green.
summary: A static diagonal gradient: deep indigo in the lower-left corner travelling through mid blue and turquoise to a fresh mint green in the upper right, presented as a wide rounded block.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle on a near-black stage, painted along a diagonal axis. It starts as dark indigo at the lower left, crosses royal blue and a bright turquoise, and finishes in pale mint green at the upper right.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds, and the same diagonal blend is shown throughout.
search_phrases: css gradient going corner to corner
use_when: A cool diagonal wash should sit behind a product or data page without competing with it.
avoid_when: The four stops are fixed in code; changing the palette or direction needs a source edit.
customise: className and style adjust size and can override the paint; the four gradient stops are written in the file.
weight_why: A single div with one CSS gradient; no animation or script.

a11y.note: Decorative surface with no controls, so accessibility actions do not apply.

issues: Packet says full-bleed but the frames show a rounded panel inset inside a black stage.
polish_why: Blend is even and the corners are tidy; otherwise an ordinary swatch.
